ci.bounds: the wider of the cluster bootstrap and the item-level Wilson interval

example_line: org prompt "... Drawer 8 holds the Belgium file. ... Drawer 2 holds the Germany file. ... Drawer 7 holds the Iraq file. ... What drawer keeps the file on the country whose capital is Brussels?" -> answer org 8; the alt prompt asks about the Germany (bridge alt), its 5th statement. Possible answers after the patch: 2 (answer of bridge alt's statement), 7 (answer at the same statement slot), 5 (the alt prompt's own answer), 8 (answer org kept).
